journey.name: wallet restore during optional identity outage
journey.description: Use a disposable test-network wallet with a complete VSS backup and a saved Pubky identity. Required wallet, private reservation and USDT recovery imports must succeed before the injected delay starts. Delay only final identity activation or subsequent profile/contact reads. Keep metadata credential replacement and required restore imports available. These complete-app fault controls are not currently provisioned; component test results are separate evidence. Never use live funds or reset an existing wallet.

actions.action: Restore the complete backup and hold final identity activation; verify ordinary wallet access resumes after required recovery completes, without reporting Paykit authenticated or payment-ready
Trigger a full backup while the saved identity cannot be exported; verify failure retains the previous complete WALLET record and required pending backup work
Close the restore screen, release the identity fault and verify retained work completes and a fresh complete backup succeeds once

Fail the restored identity's own public profile read, then reconnect or resume while staying on Home; verify wallet maintenance continues while the read is held, and the saved profile replaces the placeholder after release without opening Profile or re-importing the active session
Repeat with delayed profile/contact enrichment, then replace or remove the identity; verify late results cannot republish the old identity or overwrite current profile data
Restart during the outage; verify saved credentials resume recovery without duplicating a payment or contact mutation
Fail a required wallet or USDT restore instead; verify spending and address allocation remain gated and retry resumes the same required recovery
